entities.name: Pembela Tanah Air Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Pembela Tanah Air Museum is museum in Bogor, Indonesia. It was established to provide a tribute to former soldiers (PETA) for their contributions in establishing the nation. The museum also gives an overview of Indonesia's independence struggle and preparation to fulfil its independence.
